text: One possibility worth examining is that the quiet feels loaded because you're connecting the effort you put into helping someone with a sense of being needed. It's possible that, during the weekend, you associated being helpful with feeling valuable, and now that it's over, you're experiencing a sense of emptiness or loss of purpose. This might be a reflection of how your sense of self-worth is tied to being needed or useful to others. It may be worth looking at how you've connected helping with your own value.
